# f5xc_alert_receiver (Resource)

Alert Receiver is used to specify a receiver (slack, pagerDuty, etc.,) to send the alert notifications.<br>An Alert Receiver may be associated with one or more Alert Policy objects, which defines one or more routes to match<br>the incoming alert.

To get more information about f5xc_alert_receiver, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/alert-receiver)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Alert Receiver - Basic Email

resource "f5xc_alert_receiver" "example" {
  name        = "example-alert-receiver"
  namespace   = "default"
  description = "Alert receiver example"

  receiver_choice = {
    email = {
      email = "alerts@example.com"
    }
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Alert Receiver - Full Webhook

resource "f5xc_alert_receiver" "example" {
  name        = "example-alert-receiver"
  namespace   = "default"
  description = "Webhook receiver example updated"

  labels = {
    env  = "example"
    team = "sre"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "platform"
  }
  receiver_choice = {
    webhook = {
      url = {
        secret_info_choice = {
          clear_secret_info = {
            url = "string:///aHR0cHM6Ly9leGFtcGxlLmNvbS93ZWJob29r"
          }
        }
      }
      http_config = {
        auth_choice = {
          basic_auth = {
            user_name = "api-user"
            password = {
              secret_info_choice = {
                clear_secret_info = {
                  url = "string:///ZXhhbXBsZS1wYXNzd29yZA=="
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
        enable_http2     = true
        follow_redirects = true
        tls_choice = {
          use_tls = {
            sni_choice = {
              sni = "alerts.example.com"
            }
            min_version = ["TLSv1_2"]
            max_version = ["TLSv1_3"]
            server_validation_choice = {
              volterra_trusted_ca = true
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="nestedatt--receiver_choice--webhook--url--secret_info_choice--blindfold_secret_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `receiver_choice.webhook.url.secret_info_choice.blindfold_secret_info`

Required:

<a id="nestedatt--receiver_choice--webhook--url--secret_info_choice--clear_secret_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `receiver_choice.webhook.url.secret_info_choice.clear_secret_info`

Required:

- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL URL of the secret. Currently supported URL schemes is string:///. For string:/// scheme, Secret needs to be encoded Base64 format. When asked for this secret, caller will get Secret bytes after Base64 decoding.

Optional:

- `provider` (String) Provider Name of the Secret Management Access object that contains information about the store to get encrypted bytes This field needs to be provided only if the url scheme is not string:///

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_alert_receiver.example <namespace>/<name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<name>"
	to = f5xc_alert_receiver.example
}
```
